args.body:
Dear Mr Reyes,

Thank you for your enquiry. The CEN-1987 ledger is held in the Basement Annex (shelf C). It is not available for online viewing, and the scanned copy is restricted to internal use, so I cannot send you images or excerpts. Ledgers may be consulted in person in the reading room on Annex days (Tuesdays and Thursdays only), but they may not be photocopied or removed.

Please note that the desk staff cannot fetch items for you in advance.

Kind regards,
Marta Hale
Head Archivist, Harrowgate Public Library
